about_short_description.short_description: Pran Arabia is a food and beverage company that provides confectionery, bakery products, frozen foods, snacks, and dairy products.

product.name: Confectionery Products
product.description: Food items including chocolates, candies, toffees, gums, and lollipops designed for consumption as sweets or treats.

product.name: Bakery Products
product.description: Baked goods including biscuits, bread buns, cakes, cookies, rolls, toast, wafers, and cream rolls for consumption as snacks or meal accompaniments.

product.name: Frozen Foods
product.description: Pre-prepared frozen food items including paratha, roti, and other ready-to-cook products for convenient meal preparation.

product.name: Snacks
product.description: Various snack foods such as potato chips, crackers, puff corn, and local ethnic snacks for casual consumption.

product.name: Dairy Products
product.description: Dairy items including fresh milk, pasteurized milk, UHT milk, flavored milk, yogurt, butter, cheese, ghee, and powdered milk for nutritional consumption.
